blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Coron and Cuyo in Palawan are forecast to record the highest heat index on Sunday, the weather bureau said. In its latest heat index forecast issued on Saturday, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the two municipalities may experience a “dangerous” heat index of 42°C.
